headline: Proposed building sites and wetlands at 225 East Main Street, 59 Camp Street, and 220 and 234 Riverside Avenue were viewed on site.
summary: Engineers and surveyors showed the proposed building location and river wetlands at 225 East Main Street. At 59 Camp Street, three auger holes were dug at the current wetlands boundary, and samples were shared. The public hearing on Application #2082 and #26-467F-320 will be on Monday December 7, 2026.
